description: Potential Secret in Launch Configuration User Data
rationale: User data is stored with the launch configuration and handed unencrypted to every instance created from it, where the metadata service serves it to anything able to reach it from the instance. A secret written there is copied to each new instance for as long as the group launches from the configuration, is readable by anyone who can describe it, and cannot be rotated at all without replacing the configuration, as it is immutable. Credentials and keys belong in Secrets Manager or Parameter Store, fetched at boot with the permissions of the instance profile.
remediation: Rotate whatever was exposed, replace the launch configuration with a launch template whose user data retrieves the values from Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store, and point the Auto Scaling group at it
